rationale: Ahmad brings deep expertise in AI-native hardware form factors and spatial computing from his work on Vision Pro and Leap Motion, while Georgi is building multi-agent automation systems for startup GTM workflows—complementary perspectives on how AI reshapes user interaction and business operations. Both are in San Francisco and focused on moving beyond incremental improvements to fundamentally new categories (Ahmad: novel hardware form factors distinct from wearables; Georgi: agentic outcomes vs. dashboard-driven tools). This could spark ideas around how hardware interfaces and AI agents converge for next-gen startup tooling.
intro_message: Ahmad Abbas, meet Georgi—you're both rethinking how AI should be integrated into products from first principles (hardware form factors vs. workflow automation), and exploring what's possible when you move past existing paradigms.
